chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: O God, I ask You by the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
That You send prayer upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and fulfill my need.
ai.seo_question: What is the short supplication for fulfilling needs based on the right of Muhammad and his family?
ai.summary: This supplication, found in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, emphasizes the theological concept of *al-haqq* (the right/authority) of the Prophet and Ahl al-Bayt as a means of intercession (*tawassul*) to fulfill worldly needs. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the spiritual proximity of the Imams to God, linking divine favor directly to the lineage of the Prophet. The inclusion of *salawat* underscores the reciprocal relationship between the believer and the Ahl al-Bayt, where invoking their status invites divine mercy.
